name: Mudlet
description: dblsqd updater verifies a SHA-256 and refuses unverified installs by default (well-engineered), but the checksum comes from the same GitHub Releases endpoint with no pinned key. Package manager loads Lua/XML with zero verification.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Targeted source read supports this narrow assessment: The primary updater calls downloadRelease with checksum enforcement enabled; the checksum is obtained from the GitHub release channel.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact behavior or upstream configuration.
Where verification is delegated to an external framework/package, that implementation was not vendored and remains unresolved.

original_evidence.text: | Mudlet | https://github.com/Mudlet/Mudlet.git | a7cf7a2dbb92 / 2026-08-22 | Y | Y (opt-in toggle, on by default per `dblsqd::UpdateDialog::autoDownloadEnabled(true, ...)`) | Y | https (GitHub Releases API + release assets; `QNetworkRequest::RedirectPolicyAttribute` set to `NoLessSafeRedirectPolicy`, no TLS-verification-disable found) | N/A (no code-signed manifest; GitHub Releases JSON is unsigned) | **hash (SHA256)** — required by default (`requireChecksums=true`); download is rejected if no checksum published or if it fails to match | server-supplied/unpinned — the SHA256SUMS file is fetched from the *same* GitHub Releases endpoint as the binary itself (no separate signing key, no pinned public key in the binary) | `src/updater.cpp:324` `feed->downloadRelease(release, /*requireChecksums=*/true)`; `src/updater/Feed.cpp:222-228` refuses to install if no checksums; `src/updater/Feed.cpp:271-318` `fetchChecksums()`; `src/updater/Feed.cpp:492-509` computes `QCryptographicHash::Sha256` over the downloaded file and rejects on mismatch |

fields.label: auto(Y/N)
fields.value: Y (opt-in toggle, on by default per `dblsqd::UpdateDialog::autoDownloadEnabled(true, ...)`)

fields.label: transport
fields.value: https (GitHub Releases API + release assets; `QNetworkRequest::RedirectPolicyAttribute` set to `NoLessSafeRedirectPolicy`, no TLS-verification-disable found)

fields.label: manifest_signed
fields.value: N/A (no code-signed manifest; GitHub Releases JSON is unsigned)

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: **hash (SHA256)** — required by default (`requireChecksums=true`); download is rejected if no checksum published or if it fails to match

fields.label: verifying_key_source
fields.value: server-supplied/unpinned — the SHA256SUMS file is fetched from the *same* GitHub Releases endpoint as the binary itself (no separate signing key, no pinned public key in the binary)
